manualEvidence.title: AN 11-45G-1 Handbook of Instructions for Lower Ball Turrets Types A-2, A-2A and A-13

pages.finding: A-13 is the B-24 lower ball turret and carries two caliber .50 type M-2 aircraft machine guns.
Ball diameter 44 in; fuselage opening 46.75 in; extension about 24 in; A-13 retraction 28 in.
Front support accepts E-10 Edgewater adapter; rear brackets provide lateral and vertical gun adjustment; seat is secured to the armor plate section.
Exploded assembly identifies ammunition boxes, trunnion support, end bells, front/rear gun mounts, armor seat and door.
Installation sequence slides guns into rear brackets, installs link-ejection chutes, and secures front mounts with Edgewater adapter bolts.
Complete B-24 A-13 installation shows the retraction system and surrounding airframe support.
